title: MILO Marathon Cebu Leg 2026 Review: Queen City Qualifier
seo_title: MILO Marathon Cebu Leg 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: National MILO Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg: September 6. RUNRIO's premier series qualifier in the Queen City of the South.
dek: Set for 6 September 2026 in Cebu City, this RUNRIO-produced MILO Marathon qualifying leg brings the series to the Philippines' oldest city.
verdict: The MILO Marathon Cebu Leg is a RUNRIO-produced MILO series qualifier in Cebu City — the Philippines' oldest urban centre and the 'Queen City of the South.' Five distances from 1K to 21K. RUNRIO's production ensures professional standards. September in Cebu is the transition into the northeast monsoon. Cebu's mix of urban infrastructure and heritage landmarks makes for a distinctive race setting. A key MILO series qualifier in one of the country's most vibrant cities.

sections.heading: MILO in the Queen City
paragraphs: Cebu City is the Philippines' oldest urban centre and second-largest metropolitan area — a destination with heritage landmarks, a vibrant food scene, and easy access to beaches. [1] The MILO series in Cebu is one of the circuit's most competitive qualifying legs.
